id: WIN-ID-01 (Windows pids: SessionStart's records in the Git Bash and PowerShell shapes)
note: Under Git Bash's perl the CLAUDE_PID a hook anchors on is Claude Code's Windows pid, which kill 0 and /proc do not know (PC sittings 5 and 6: winpid 12044 is MSYS pid 772). identity::win_probe maps it to its MSYS pid (Cygwin::winpid_to_pid, else /proc/*/winpid) and reads that pid's /proc start, so SessionStart writes a real pid_lstart and a record key with its start; a claude started from PowerShell has no MSYS pid and only `ps -W` lists it: alive-unknown, the start null as before. Seams (test mode): STORE_TEST_OS msys, STORE_TEST_PROC_ROOT (a stand-in /proc: btime and the MSYS pid's stat, start = btime), STORE_TEST_WINPIDS (the winpid map: 12044 is the runner's pid, which runs on every host) and STORE_TEST_PS_W (the listing: 12044 and 22192); STORE_TEST_PPID 1 as a hook's perl sees it there. A skill's helper under the Bash tool's shells (STORE_TEST_PPID 885 and STORE_TEST_PROC: 885 -> 841 -> 1, no Claude Code above) cannot climb to Claude Code there, so the walk takes CLAUDE_PID, found, unless that pid is gone (identity::_walk); without the Cygwin sub the map is one scan of /proc/*/winpid (STORE_TEST_NO_CYGWIN, no STORE_TEST_WINPIDS)

steps.name: Git Bash shape: the winpid maps to a running MSYS pid, whose /proc start the records hold
PowerShell shape: no MSYS pid, ps -W lists it: alive-unknown, its start null
a skill's helper under the Bash tool's shells (885 -> 841 -> 1, Git Bash shape): the walk cannot climb, CLAUDE_PID is the anchor
the same in the PowerShell shape: CLAUDE_PID, its start unknown
a CLAUDE_PID that is gone (neither mapped nor listed) is never taken: the walk's start, as before
a perl without Cygwin::winpid_to_pid (and no map seam) reads one scan of /proc/*/winpid
